salt_pct.quote: * salt (NaCl) % = **1.36 %** – commercial Morbier, raw cow, 2-3 mo, France, natural rind. URL above.

ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino acid deamination by Brevibacterium linens smear, low at 2-3 mo

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp by raw-milk lactobacilli and smear coryneforms

bitter.reason: hydrophobic peptides from rennet and plasmin proteolysis, moderate in pressed paste

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no C7-C11 methyl ketones from blue mold lipolysis

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine from proteolysis on heating

buttery.reason: diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis

cheesy_sweaty.reason: butanoic acid from lipolysis plus 42.5 mg/kg isovaleric acids from Leu catabolism

creaminess.reason: 26% fat and 46% moisture with smeared proteolyzed paste coating mouth

crumbliness.reason: pressed non-cooked curd fuses to supple paste, not dry granular fracture

firmness.reason: pressed uncooked semi-hard paste at ~46% moisture and pH 5.4, sliceable supple

floral_honey.reason: low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from Phe catabolism by LAB

fruity.reason: ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids by smear yeasts

goaty.reason: cow milk lacks 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids, only low C6-C8 from lipolysis

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanol from Leu/Ile Strecker degradation and PAB activity

melt.reason: pH 5.4 demineralized rennet curd with solubilized colloidal calcium flows on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid lipoxygenase oxidation plus smear rind geosmin

oil_off.reason: free oil coalescence from 26% fat network on melting, moderate lipolysis

smoky.reason: central vegetable ash line is flavorless carbon, no wood-smoke guaiacol, not smoked

sour_vinegar.reason: lactic acid from mesophilic starters plus low acetic acid, pH 5.4 interior

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata hot-water kneading, rennet gel gives flow not fibrous stretch

sulfur_cooked.reason: low methanethiol/dimethyl disulfide from Met catabolism by Brevibacterium

sweet.reason: lactose depleted to lactate, slight sweetness from free amino acids and diacetyl

umami.reason: free glutamate from chymosin and LAB peptidase proteolysis during 3 mo ripening
